info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Finance Financial Statements-spec
info.description: The Financial Statements Retrieval API allows users to access comprehensive financial statements associated with their banking data. With this API, developers can obtain detailed reports on various financial conditions, enabling informed decision-making. Typical consumers include financial analysts, accounting software developers, and banking institutions seeking to provide insights into client finances. The API supports multiple request parameters to filter and customize the financial data returned, ensuring relevant and actionable information is readily available.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the financial statements, which provide a comprehensive overview of the financial performance and position of the entity. Use this endpoint to obtain essential accounting documents such as income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow statements.
